User Story: As a customer, I want to register so that I can create an account.
As a customer, I want to manage addresses so that checkout is faster.
As a customer, I want to search and filter products so that I can find relevant items quickly.
As a customer, I want personalized recommendations so that I can discover relevant products.
As a customer, I want my cart to persist so that I do not lose selected products.
As a customer, I want to apply valid coupons so that I receive eligible discounts.
As a customer, I want a simplified checkout so that I can complete purchases quickly.
As a customer, I want multiple payment methods so that I can choose a convenient option.
As a customer, I want to retry a failed payment without creating a duplicate order.
As an operations user, I want near-real-time inventory availability so that overselling is reduced.
As a customer, I want real-time order tracking so that I know where my order is.
As an operations user, I want automated order status updates so that manual work is reduced.
As a customer, I want to request eligible returns online so that I do not need manual support.
As a customer, I want eligible refunds initiated automatically so that refund time is reduced.
As a customer, I want order notifications so that I stay informed.
As an executive, I want a real-time sales dashboard so that I can monitor performance.
As an operations manager, I want an inventory dashboard so that I can identify stock issues.
